shots.scene: 欣欣举着一个放大镜，对着一颗发光的小原子核图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a big magnifying glass up to a small glowing atomic nucleus icon, smiling at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，我们学怎样挑一颗好核素。
overlay: 医学成像用放射性核素的性质：有效半衰期

shots.scene: 沙漏、出口门、稳定的小方块和人体轮廓四个图标排成一排
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: an hourglass, an exit door, a calm solid cube and a simple human body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 关键词：半衰期、排出、安全。

shots.scene: 老周在走廊上打电话，表情犹豫，手腕上贴着一小块空白胶布
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands in a corridor talking on a phone with a hesitant face, a small blank plaster on the back of his hand.
shots.narration: 老周刚做完核医学检查。

shots.scene: 老周看着手背上的胶布，头顶一个沙漏和问号
shots.prompt_en: The older man looks at the small plaster on his hand, an hourglass and a question mark floating above his head.
shots.narration: 他想：药会在身体里留多久？

shots.scene: 小研在电脑前对比两张空白卡片，每张上有一个沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sits at a computer comparing two blank cards, each with an hourglass icon of a different size.
shots.narration: 小研的课题要选一种显像核素。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头顶冒出两个沙漏和一个问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head, with two hourglass icons and a question mark floating above him.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：为什么它们都要很快消失？

shots.scene: 欣欣站在三人中间，手里拿着一个沙漏
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between the older man, the female graduate student and the young male student, holding up an hourglass.
shots.narration: 答案藏在有效半衰期里。

shots.section_title: 用影像看身体里的问题
shots.scene: 医生图标看着一块发光的空白看片灯箱
shots.prompt_en: A simple doctor pictogram looks at a glowing blank light box on the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 医生常靠影像判断身体哪里出问题。
overlay: 用影像看身体里的问题

shots.section_title: 用影像看身体里的问题
shots.scene: 两束箭头：一束标X射线图标，一束标γ射线图标，指向人体轮廓
shots.prompt_en: Two bundles of arrows point at a human body outline, one marked with a box-shaped tube icon, the other with a small glowing nucleus icon. No people.
shots.narration: 影像可以用X射线，也可以用γ射线。

shots.section_title: X射线：各组织拦得不一样
shots.scene: X射线箭头从左侧射入人体轮廓，从背后射出落在空白底片上
shots.prompt_en: Arrows from a box-shaped tube icon on the left pass through a human body outline and land on a blank film plate behind it. No people.
shots.narration: 拍X光片，射线从体外穿过身体。
overlay: X射线：各组织拦得不一样

shots.section_title: X射线：各组织拦得不一样
shots.scene: 人体内分成肌肉、血液、骨骼三种颜色区域，各自拦下不同数量的小球
shots.prompt_en: Inside a body outline, three colored regions for muscle, blood and bone each stop a different number of small bright balls. No people.
shots.narration: 肌肉、血液、骨头，拦射线的本领不同。

shots.section_title: X射线：各组织拦得不一样
shots.scene: 底片上出现深浅不一的影子图案
shots.prompt_en: The film plate now shows a shadow pattern with light and dark areas of bones and soft tissue. No people.
shots.narration: 穿过来的多少不同，底片上就有图案。

shots.scene: 一个全部由同样灰色方块拼成的人体，底片一片均匀灰
shots.prompt_en: A body outline made entirely of identical grey blocks, and behind it a film plate that is evenly grey with no pattern. No people.
shots.narration: 假如全身都一样，底片就一片均匀。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着均匀灰色的底片摇头，旁边是一张有图案的底片打勾
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head at an evenly grey film, then points to a patterned film with a green check mark.
shots.narration: 正是不均匀，才让我们看出东西。

shots.scene: 射线源在人体外面，箭头从前面进、后面出
shots.prompt_en: A ray source icon sits outside a human body outline; arrows enter from the front and leave from the back. No people.
shots.narration: X射线从外面进来，再从后面出去。

shots.scene: 一个写着“外部”的小门图标在体外，箭头一路直穿
shots.prompt_en: A small door icon outside the body outline with straight parallel arrows passing all the way through. No people.
shots.narration: 所以它叫外部成像技术。

shots.scene: 一个小小的γ源图标放在体外，射线向四面八方散开
shots.prompt_en: A tiny gamma source icon placed outside a body outline, with rays spreading out in all directions like a small lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 能不能把γ源也放在体外照？

shots.scene: 老李把一小罐源放进厚厚的屏蔽罐，旁边“少量”字样
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, wearing gloves and a dosimeter badge, sets a tiny shielded pot inside a thick shielding container.
shots.narration: γ源放射性强，用量只能很少。

shots.scene: 点光源照向人体：近处亮、远处暗，光线不平行
shots.prompt_en: A small point light shines at a body outline: the near side is bright, the far side is dim, and the rays fan out instead of being parallel. No people.
shots.narration: 点状的源，光线不平行，照得不均匀。

shots.scene: 欣欣两手一摊，面前是被红叉划掉的“体外γ源照射”图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot spreads its paws in front of a crossed-out icon of a gamma source shining from outside a body.
shots.narration: 这样做和拍X光没什么区别。

shots.section_title: 把核素随载体送进身体
shots.scene: 一个小光点骑在一辆送货小车上，小车开进人体轮廓
shots.prompt_en: A tiny glowing dot rides on a small delivery cart, and the cart drives into a human body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 新思路：把核素和某种物质绑在一起。
overlay: 把核素随载体送进身体

shots.section_title: 把核素随载体送进身体
shots.scene: 人体轮廓里，小光点沿着血管均匀流动
shots.prompt_en: Inside a body outline, many tiny glowing dots flow evenly along simple blood vessel lines. No people.
shots.narration: 送进身体后，随血液在全身循环。

shots.section_title: 把核素随载体送进身体
shots.scene: 病人图标戴着吸入面罩，光点随呼吸进入体内
shots.prompt_en: A patient pictogram wearing a small breathing mask, glowing dots entering the body with each breath. No people.
shots.narration: 让病人把它吸入体内。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓中一个器官的一小块区域像磁铁一样吸引光点
shots.prompt_en: Inside a body outline, one small spot in an organ attracts glowing dots like a magnet. No people.
shots.narration: 有些病变细胞，特别爱吸收某种物质。

shots.scene: 开始全身光点均匀，过一会儿那一小块越来越亮
shots.prompt_en: At first the glowing dots are spread evenly through the body, then over time one small spot becomes much brighter than the rest. No people.
shots.narration: 过一段时间，光点在那里越聚越多。

shots.scene: 体外几个空白探测器方块，对着亮点的那个收到最多光点
shots.prompt_en: Several blank detector blocks around the body outline; the block facing the bright spot catches the most light dots. No people.
shots.narration: 体外探测器发现那里的γ光子特别多。

shots.scene: 医生图标指着图像上的亮点，旁边一个感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A simple doctor pictogram points at a bright spot on a blank body image, with an exclamation mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 医生就知道，那个部位可能有情况。

shots.section_title: 多角度接收，计算机成像
shots.scene: 左边X射线箭头整齐同向穿过身体，右边光点从体内向四周发光
shots.prompt_en: Split picture: on the left, parallel arrows pass through a body in one direction; on the right, light shines out from inside the body in all directions. No people.
shots.narration: X射线方向一致，γ从体内向四周发。
overlay: 多角度接收，计算机成像

shots.section_title: 多角度接收，计算机成像
shots.scene: 探测器方块绕着人体转到不同角度
shots.prompt_en: Blank detector blocks move around a body outline, stopping at several different angles. No people.
shots.narration: 探测器从不同角度接收γ光子。

shots.section_title: 多角度接收，计算机成像
shots.scene: 一台空白屏幕的电脑把几张侧影拼成一张立体图像
shots.prompt_en: A computer with a blank screen combines several flat shadow pictures into one simple three-dimensional organ image. No people.
shots.narration: 计算机把这些信息拼成图像。

shots.section_title: 多角度接收，计算机成像
shots.scene: 图像上的亮点被一个圆圈标出
shots.prompt_en: A simple organ image with one bright spot circled. No people.
shots.narration: 从而找到病灶的位置。

shots.scene: 一颗光点和一个小分子积木拼在一起，像贴上发光标签
shots.prompt_en: A glowing dot snaps onto a small molecule made of building blocks, like attaching a glowing tag. No people.
shots.narration: 核素常连在盐或有机化合物上。

shots.scene: 带光点的分子顺着路线自己走到一个目标器官
shots.prompt_en: The tagged molecule travels by itself along a path to one target organ in a body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 靠这种物质的代谢特点，聚到目标器官。

shots.scene: 小研举起一个带电离辐射警告标志的空白药瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves and a dosimeter badge, holds up a blank vial with an ionizing radiation warning sign.
shots.narration: 贴上放射性标记的药物，叫放射性药物。

shots.section_title: 生物半衰期：身体往外排
shots.scene: 一个浴缸里装着蓝色的水，底部排水口慢慢往外流
shots.prompt_en: A bathtub filled with blue water, with the drain at the bottom slowly letting water out. No people.
shots.narration: 先想象身体是一个浴缸。
overlay: 生物半衰期：身体往外排

shots.section_title: 生物半衰期：身体往外排
shots.scene: 人体轮廓里普通药物小球经由代谢箭头和出口门慢慢离开
shots.prompt_en: Plain medicine balls inside a body outline slowly leave through metabolism arrows and an exit door. No people.
shots.narration: 普通药物会被代谢、排泄，慢慢离开。

shots.section_title: 生物半衰期：身体往外排
shots.scene: 排水口旁一个小沙漏图标，水位降到一半
shots.prompt_en: A small hourglass icon beside the drain while the water level drops to half. No people.
shots.narration: 排掉一半的时间，叫生物半衰期。

shots.scene: 一个密封小瓶放在架子上，瓶里光点一个个熄灭
shots.prompt_en: A sealed small vial sits on a shelf, and the glowing dots inside go out one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 核素放在瓶子里，也会自己衰变。

shots.scene: 瓶子旁的沙漏，光点亮度降到一半
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass next to the vial while the overall glow drops to half. No people.
shots.narration: 活度减半的时间，叫物理半衰期。

shots.section_title: 有效半衰期：两条路一起走
shots.scene: 浴缸既有排水口往下流，水面又在蒸发冒气
shots.prompt_en: The bathtub is draining from the bottom and at the same time the water surface is evaporating with rising steam. No people.
shots.narration: 药物进了身体，两条路同时在走。
overlay: 有效半衰期：两条路一起走

shots.section_title: 有效半衰期：两条路一起走
shots.scene: 两条出口箭头：一个“衰变”，一个“排出”，共同指向外面
shots.prompt_en: Two exit arrows lead out of a body outline together, one with a fading dot icon, one with an exit door icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一边衰变，一边被排出体外。

shots.section_title: 有效半衰期：两条路一起走
shots.scene: 三个沙漏比大小：两个大的，一个最小的放在中间
shots.prompt_en: Three hourglasses compared side by side: two larger ones on the sides and the smallest one in the middle, highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 合起来的有效半衰期，比两者都短。

shots.section_title: 有效半衰期：两条路一起走
shots.scene: 几个不同的人形图标，各自身边的沙漏大小不同
shots.prompt_en: Several different human figure icons, each with an hourglass of a different size beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 它随药物、器官，甚至病情因人而异。

shots.section_title: 桌上的源与身体里的源
shots.scene: 桌上一个密封源放在透明盒里，周围有警戒标志，钟表转了很多圈
shots.prompt_en: A sealed source in a clear box on a table with an ionizing radiation warning sign nearby, and a clock beside it spinning many rounds. No people.
shots.narration: 桌上盒里的钴60，只按物理半衰期衰减。
overlay: 桌上的源与身体里的源

shots.section_title: 桌上的源与身体里的源
shots.scene: 人体轮廓里有流动的箭头、消化和排泄的循环图标
shots.prompt_en: Inside a body outline, moving arrows show circulation, digestion and excretion like a busy little factory. No people.
shots.narration: 身体却是个流动的系统，会往外排。

shots.section_title: 桌上的源与身体里的源
shots.scene: 大部分光点从出口门离开，但有一两个留在角落里
shots.prompt_en: Most glowing dots leave through the exit door, but one or two remain stuck in a corner of the body. No people.
shots.narration: 可总有一点可能留在体内。

shots.section_title: 桌上的源与身体里的源
shots.scene: 留下的光点旁的沙漏几乎不动，周围组织出现警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Next to the remaining dot an hourglass barely moves, and a warning triangle appears over the nearby tissue. No people.
shots.narration: 半衰期很长，就会成为癌症的源头。

shots.section_title: 桌上的源与身体里的源
shots.scene: 钴60小光点连在药片上，药片旁警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A small glowing dot attached to a tablet icon, with a warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 假如把钴60连在药上吃下，危害长久。

shots.scene: 一根快燃尽的短蜡烛，旁边打勾；一根很长的蜡烛打叉
shots.prompt_en: A short candle that is almost burnt out with a green check mark, next to a very tall candle with a red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 所以诊断用的核素，半衰期要短。

shots.scene: 相机图标拍完照，体内光点很快变暗
shots.prompt_en: A camera icon takes a picture, and right afterward the glowing dots inside the body quickly fade. No people.
shots.narration: 最好五分钟后，就衰变排出体外。

shots.scene: 欣欣比出一个零的手势，旁边体内光点全部熄灭
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot makes a zero sign with its paw while all the glowing dots in a body outline go dark.
shots.narration: 就算还在体内，也根本不再有放射性。

shots.section_title: 半衰期几个小时最合适
shots.scene: 一条时间线：制备—运送—注射，旁边一个几小时的钟面图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple timeline with three icons: preparing a vial, a delivery box, and a syringe, with a small clock face above. No people.
shots.narration: 理想的物理半衰期，约为几个小时。
overlay: 半衰期几个小时最合适

shots.section_title: 半衰期几个小时最合适
shots.scene: 和从制备到注射所需时间差不多的沙漏
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass whose sand runs out just as the timeline reaches the syringe icon. No people.
shots.narration: 和从制备到注射的时间差不多。

shots.section_title: 半衰期几个小时最合适
shots.scene: 患者图标做一次检查；工作人员图标在日历上天天打卡
shots.prompt_en: A patient pictogram with a single check mark, next to a staff pictogram with a calendar full of daily ticks. No people.
shots.narration: 患者只做一次，工作人员却天天接触。

shots.section_title: 半衰期几个小时最合适
shots.scene: 工作人员图标身边的剂量柱一天天累积升高
shots.prompt_en: Beside the staff pictogram, a small bar slowly grows taller day after day. No people.
shots.narration: 一年下来，会累积大量放射性。

shots.section_title: 半衰期几个小时最合适
shots.scene: 太长的沙漏打叉；太短的沙漏旁堆着一大堆药瓶也打叉
shots.prompt_en: A very long hourglass with a red cross, and a tiny hourglass beside a big pile of vials also with a red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 太长不行；太短又得多准备很多活度。

shots.scene: 一个光点衰变后变成安静的灰色小方块
shots.prompt_en: A glowing dot decays into a calm grey solid cube that no longer glows. No people.
shots.narration: 衰变后的子体，最好是稳定的。

shots.scene: 灰色小方块旁一个巨大的沙漏，几乎不动
shots.prompt_en: Next to the grey cube stands a huge hourglass whose sand barely moves. No people.
shots.narration: 至少也要寿命极长，比如锝99约20万年。

shots.scene: γ光子箭头从人体中穿出被探测器接住，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Gamma photon arrows come out of a body outline and are caught by a blank detector block, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 成像只需要能穿出身体的γ光子。

shots.scene: α、β小粒子和很低能的光子在组织里很快停下，留下红点，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Small alpha and beta particle icons and very weak photon icons stop quickly inside tissue, leaving red marks, all crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: α、β和低能光子跑不远，只留下剂量。

shots.scene: 两个小图标：原子核内部重排、原子核吸进一个电子
shots.prompt_en: Two small icons: a nucleus quietly rearranging itself, and a nucleus capturing an orbiting electron. No people.
shots.narration: 所以优先选同质异能跃迁或电子俘获。

shots.scene: 三支箭头：太弱的停在体内，太强的穿透一切，中间的刚好被探测到
shots.prompt_en: Three arrows: a weak one stops inside the body, a very strong one passes through everything including the detector, and a medium one is neatly caught. No people.
shots.narration: γ能量适中，50到300千电子伏，最好150。

shots.scene: 中等能量的箭头穿出身体，进入带细孔的准直器
shots.prompt_en: The medium arrow leaves the body and passes neatly through a collimator plate with fine holes into a detector. No people.
shots.narration: 够穿出身体，又容易准直和探测。

shots.section_title: 单一能量，便于去掉散射
shots.scene: 一排完全一样颜色的小球，整齐排队
shots.prompt_en: A row of identical small balls, all exactly the same color, lined up neatly. No people.
shots.narration: 最好发出单一能量的γ射线。
overlay: 单一能量，便于去掉散射

shots.section_title: 单一能量，便于去掉散射
shots.scene: 能量筛子挡住颜色偏了的散射小球
shots.prompt_en: An energy sieve lets the true-colored balls through and blocks balls whose color has shifted after bouncing. No people.
shots.narration: 散射后能量变了，可以按能量筛掉。

shots.section_title: 单一能量，便于去掉散射
shots.scene: 一张简化能谱：一个高峰、一片平台、几个小峰，均无数字
shots.prompt_en: A simplified energy spectrum with one tall peak, a low flat plateau and a few small peaks, no numbers. No people.
shots.narration: 回顾能谱：全能峰、康普顿平台。

shots.section_title: 单一能量，便于去掉散射
shots.scene: 能谱上两个小峰亮起，旁边两个光子合并的小图标
shots.prompt_en: Two small peaks light up on the spectrum, next to an icon of two photons merging into one. No people.
shots.narration: 还有逃逸峰，以及源太近时的和峰。

shots.scene: 光点牢牢扣在分子积木上，室温温度计图标
shots.prompt_en: A glowing dot clicks firmly onto a molecule made of building blocks, with a room temperature thermometer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 核素要在室温下容易、牢固地标记。

shots.scene: 火箭载着卫星飞向轨道
shots.prompt_en: A small rocket carries a satellite up toward orbit around a cartoon earth. No people.
shots.narration: 药物像火箭，核素像卫星。

shots.scene: 卫星太重，火箭飞不起来，被红叉
shots.prompt_en: The satellite is so heavy that the rocket cannot lift off, with a red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 卫星太重，火箭就飞不出去。

shots.scene: 带光点的分子仍沿原路线顺利到达目标器官，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The tagged molecule still travels along its normal path to the target organ, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 标记后，药物的代谢行为不能变。

shots.scene: 医院旁边一个小仓库图标，送货距离很短
shots.prompt_en: A small storage building icon right next to a hospital icon with a very short delivery arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 放射性药物要在使用地方便获得。

shots.scene: 一个小瓶里光点密密麻麻
shots.prompt_en: A tiny vial packed densely with glowing dots. No people.
shots.narration: 比活度要高：一点点体积，活度够用。

shots.scene: 一个大的“母”沙漏连着一个小的“子”沙漏
shots.prompt_en: A large parent hourglass connected by a tube to a small child hourglass, slowly refilling it. No people.
shots.narration: 短寿命核素，可由长寿命的母体供应。

shots.section_title: 理想放射性药物的其他条件
shots.scene: 光点迅速大量聚到目标器官，其他地方很少
shots.prompt_en: Glowing dots gather quickly and mostly in the target organ, with very few elsewhere. No people.
shots.narration: 要快速、大量地聚到要查的组织。
overlay: 理想放射性药物的其他条件

shots.section_title: 理想放射性药物的其他条件
shots.scene: 检查时长的钟面和有效半衰期沙漏并排，长短相近
shots.prompt_en: A clock showing the exam duration side by side with an hourglass of similar length. No people.
shots.narration: 有效半衰期和检查时长相当。

shots.section_title: 理想放射性药物的其他条件
shots.scene: 过敏、毒性图标被红叉；一个笑脸患者图标
shots.prompt_en: Allergy and toxicity icons crossed out, next to a smiling patient pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 毒性低，不引起过敏等不良反应。

shots.section_title: 理想放射性药物的其他条件
shots.scene: 试管图标和人体图标，两边的分子都完整不散
shots.prompt_en: A test tube icon and a body outline icon, each holding an intact tagged molecule that does not fall apart. No people.
shots.narration: 体外、体内都要稳定，不易分解。

shots.section_title: 理想放射性药物的其他条件
shots.scene: 一个价签图标和一个打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank price tag icon with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 还要容易买到，价格合理。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上三个沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard showing three hourglass icons.
shots.narration: 我们来回顾一下今天的内容。

shots.scene: 浴缸排水又蒸发，最小的沙漏被圈出
shots.prompt_en: The draining and evaporating bathtub, with the smallest hourglass circled. No people.
shots.narration: 衰变加排出，有效半衰期比两者都短。

shots.scene: 短蜡烛、稳定方块、γ箭头、单色小球四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a short candle, a calm grey cube, a gamma arrow leaving a body, and a row of same-colored balls. No people.
shots.narration: 短寿命、子体稳、只发γ、能量单一。

shots.scene: 火箭载卫星、医院旁的仓库、打勾的笑脸患者
shots.prompt_en: A rocket carrying a satellite, a storage building beside a hospital, and a smiling patient with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 标记牢、易获得、毒性低、聚得准。

shots.scene: 探测器绕人体转动，电脑拼出图像
shots.prompt_en: Detector blocks rotate around a body outline while a computer with a blank screen assembles an image. No people.
shots.narration: 体外多角度探测，计算机重建图像。

shots.scene: 老周、小研、阿杰围在一起点头
shots.prompt_en: The older man, the female graduate student and the young male student stand together nodding.
shots.narration: 懂原理，才能挑好核素。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别，手里拿着沙漏
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with one paw, holding an hourglass in the other.
shots.narration: 挑好核素，算好时间，下次见！
